name: Name
layoutHint: Drag characters onto slots · onto an occupied slot = stack · Shift = swap · back onto the palette = remove. ⚙ on each slot opens its actions (wider/taller, keep free, split, overflow, hotkey, preview strip …). Drag grid lines by their ◆ handle.
pvEve: only while an EVE client is active
spvStack: the other (hidden) clients of this stack
spvHint: Live images as a strip over the stack, click switches to the client. "Hidden" disappears automatically when nothing is hidden.
dragCellType: Drag to move it to another slot
subgridTarget: A subgrid can only be moved to a normal cell that isn't kept free and has no subgrid.
lockHelp: Lock EVE clients in place: moving, resizing, maximizing or tiling snaps straight back.
hkHint: Global KDE shortcuts (also visible in System Settings). Click a field and press a key combination; Del/Backspace clears, Esc cancels. Active while fcwm web or watch runs. Switching layouts also makes it the active layout for auto placement.
hkStackHint: Brings the clients of this slot to the front in turn. Active while this profile is active.
tbHide: Hide title bars of EVE clients
tbHint: Implemented as our own KWin window rules (fcwm-…), works even when the tool isn't running.
sepHint: Only where two windows meet – one line per edge, none at the outer border. "Always" also draws them over other programs that cover a gap.
ofLastHint: The last overflow slot always takes all remaining clients – there is no maximum here.
ofHint: Overflow slots are not filled normally. Once all fill slots are taken, further clients go here in order (as a stack).
splitCell: Split cell into a subgrid (smaller clients)
subHint: Merging puts characters from the sub-cells as a stack into the whole cell. Subgrid lines can be dragged too.
blockCell: Keep free / for other windows (browser, RIFT, catch-all …)
dropOnBlocked: This slot is kept free – release it with ✕ first.
unpinnedForBlock: Assignment removed because the slot is kept free: {list}
cpHint: This slot never gets EVE clients. Preview: live images of the EVE clients, click switches to the client. Otherwise other windows can live here: title/window class from the list or a pattern (regex, e.g. RIFT|Brave, case-insensitive) – placed when applying and, with auto placement, as soon as a matching window opens.
dragLineRow: Drag line: this row only · Ctrl = whole line across all rows · Shift = snap to 1/12
editRawHint: Validated before saving. Unsaved changes in the editor above will be lost.
reloadHint: Reload re-reads config.yaml (e.g. after editing it by hand) – windows are not moved.
restartFailed: fcwm does not respond after restarting – check the log (journalctl --user -u fcwm)
restartDirty: Unsaved changes will be lost when restarting. Restart anyway?
autoHelp: Newly logged-in clients are moved to their slot automatically. Several simultaneous logins are batched and placed together; clients already placed stay where they are.
noChars: No characters known – log in or add one below.
unplaced: No free slot for: {list} – assign a slot or enable “fill”.
droppedGrid: Outside the new grid, assignment removed: {list}
cpStackHint: Unchecked, only the first matching window goes here. Checked, all of them do – as a stack like EVE clients (first on top). The stack hotkey and “Cycle active stack” switch between them.
cpCatchHint: While auto placement runs, every newly opened window that no other slot has a pattern for lands here (never EVE clients). Windows that are already open stay where they are. A program's dialogs/popups still open wherever the program puts them. Per profile, the first catch-all slot counts.
cpKeepSizeHint: Windows are only moved (centered in the slot), not stretched to the slot size – small messages stay small. They never get larger than the slot.
webHint: Address of the web UI (settings.web in the configuration). Takes effect after a restart; the page then moves to the new port by itself. The web UI only listens locally (127.0.0.1) – it can move windows and overwrite the configuration.
webMoving: fcwm is restarting on port {port} – redirecting …
serviceOn: Connected to the fcwm service – changes and events appear live.
serviceOff: fcwm service not reachable – it is not running or restarting. Reconnecting automatically.
dbgCopied: Debug info copied to the clipboard
copyManual: Could not access the clipboard – the text is selected below, copy it with Ctrl+C
dbgIssueHint: Markdown in English, including your config. Character names are replaced with placeholders like “Caldari Citizen 1”; serial numbers and your home path are left out.
dbgIssueCopied: Debug info copied as Markdown – paste it into the issue
aboutTagline: Window manager for EVE Online on KDE Plasma: grid layouts, profiles, stacks, hotkeys and live previews for multiboxing.
donateText: Enjoying FleetCommander? It's free and stays free – if you'd like to say thanks, the developer is happy about an ISK donation in game to:
donateStep1: In EVE, search for the character “Mister Forever” (People & Places or the search bar).
donateStep3: Enter an amount – optionally a reason like “FleetCommander” – and confirm.
donateNote: The portrait is loaded from the official EVE image server. Donations are voluntary and give no extra features.
creditsText: Developed by Jan-Frederic Schubert. Thanks to everyone who tests, reports bugs or translates.
